entities.name: Service Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to request service establishment or reactivation of PDU sessions.

entities.name: SERVICE ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to accept service request and provide session status information.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate service request procedure.

entities.name: PDU session status
entities.description: IE indicating status of PDU sessions for synchronization between UE and AMF.

entities.name: PDU session reactivation result
entities.description: IE indicating result of user-plane resources re-establishment for PDU sessions.

entities.name: Allowed PDU session status
entities.description: IE indicating PDU sessions for which UE allows user-plane reactivation.

entities.name: Uplink data status
entities.description: IE indicating PDU sessions with pending uplink data.

entities.name: Paging restriction
entities.description: IE used by MUSIM UE to request paging restrictions.

entities.name: T3517
entities.description: Timer used during service request procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: State entered by UE upon successful service request completion.

entities.name: PDU session status IE included
entities.description: Condition when PDU session status IE is present in SERVICE REQUEST or SERVICE ACCEPT message.

entities.name: Local release of PDU sessions
entities.description: Behavior where UE or AMF locally releases PDU sessions based on status mismatch.

relations.description: Reception of SERVICE ACCEPT message indicates successful completion of service request procedure.
Successful completion of service request procedure stops timer T3517.
Successful service request procedure causes UE to enter 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
SERVICE REQUEST message may contain PDU session status IE.
SERVICE ACCEPT message may contain PDU session status IE for synchronization.
When PDU session status IE is included, UE/AMF performs local release of mismatched PDU sessions.
SERVICE ACCEPT message contains PDU session reactivation result IE to indicate user-plane re-establishment results.
SERVICE REQUEST message may contain Allowed PDU session status IE.
SERVICE REQUEST message may contain Uplink data status IE.
MUSIM UE may include Paging restriction IE in SERVICE REQUEST message.
